sources.notes: A find control shows the current position against the total, steps to the previous and next results, and shades all matches while bringing the focused match into view; it needs a scope that covers the whole set.

sources.title: Mass merchant checkout benchmark, 2026
sources.notes: Checkout delivery options labelled by delivery date rather than speed alone, with order cost and delivery timing stated early; address entry aided with suggestions and validation to reduce failed deliveries.

sources.title: Multi-step form validation and hidden-step guidance
sources.notes: Packing multiple steps into one form and hiding steps can leave a required field on a hidden step blocking submission; scope validation to the visible step, check each step on transition, or give each step its own form.

sources.title: In-conversation interactive visuals guidance
sources.notes: Visuals inside a conversation should be interactive in place: tappable controls, task-specific calculators and charts, and diagrams where selecting a part changes its explanation, rather than flat pictures.

sources.title: Accessible file upload field guidance
sources.notes: An upload field states accepted formats and size limits before anyone picks a file, keeps drag-and-drop as a bonus beside a keyboard-operable browse control, announces the attached file and any failure, and offers a clear way to remove and replace a file.

sources.title: Realtime membership and presence guidance
sources.notes: Presence is a short-lived claim about an open session, not proof that a person saw, understood, or approved a change; keep typing indicators, read receipts, and approval signals separate, each with a lifetime matching what it actually knows.

sources.title: Form drafts that survive navigation guidance
sources.notes: Forms save drafts so a reload or a trip to another page restores the work with a notice that nothing new was sent; a restored draft is not a delivery receipt, and an interrupted submission needs its own checkable state rather than a generic success banner.

sources.title: Saved views guidance
sources.notes: A saved view is a bookmarked filter combination returned to with one action; it shows the matching subset as data changes rather than moving or copying items, and stays distinct from tags that label single items.

sources.title: Product image gallery zoom accessibility guidance
sources.notes: Gallery thumbnails name what each selects and mark the active one as current; viewer controls stay reachable at high magnification without horizontal scrolling, focus returns to the opening thumbnail on close, and an inline magnifier avoids viewer-layer focus rules entirely.

sources.title: When should an answer arrive as a screen: answer-shape menu
sources.notes: Fix the answer shape per intent (comparison, diagram, map, calculator, plain text) so composed answers stay inside one menu and stay consistent; offer a fewer-visuals control.

sources.title: Toast feedback guidance
sources.notes: Short non-blocking confirmations for low-stakes actions; duration scaled to message length, manual dismiss, consistent placement, announced politely.

sources.title: Accessible drag-and-drop without dragging
sources.notes: Plain buttons as the robust reorder path; the same move function for drag and button; a short polite announcement after a successful move, with focus left in place.

sources.title: Date picker design for enterprise use
sources.notes: Ranges shown with both ends in one view and the span highlighted; presets for common spans; typed entry alongside calendar picking; contrast and navigation checks.

sources.title: Accessible faceted search and filter chips
sources.notes: Group filter options under a named group, name each chip remove control for its filter, announce the new result count as a status message, and keep every filter control keyboard-operable.

sources.title: Accessible accordion and disclosure sections
sources.notes: Heading-wrapped buttons with expanded state and panel linkage, sections openable independently, and the distinction between a single disclosure, an accordion, and tabs.

sources.title: Accessible auto-rotating carousels and sliders
sources.notes: Pause control for auto-rotation, named previous, next, and slide-picker controls, rotation stopped on focus, and reduced-motion starting state.

sources.title: Designing for limited data plans and slow connections
sources.notes: Progressive loading of visible content first, flexible alternatives for slow media, content compression, and testing on simulated slow connections.

sources.title: Carousel pattern with previous and next controls
sources.notes: Rotation control labelled by the action it will perform, rotation paused while focus is inside the set, and slide changes announced without a live region during rotation.

sources.title: Interface architectures replacing the single conversational surface
sources.notes: System-initiated surfaces: the system notices, proposes, and prepares while the person confirms or redirects; ambient surfaces that speak only when they have something worth saying; background work that reports back.

sources.title: Announcing new features
sources.notes: Announcement visibility graded by impact; persistent entry point for later review; new-item labels time-limited and never used for minor changes.

sources.title: Announcing product updates
sources.notes: In-app announcement channels by job: banner for time-sensitive notices, guided tour for workflow changes, persistent updates hub for later review; one action per announcement.

sources.title: Version history management
sources.notes: Named versions at milestones, compare views with marked additions and removals, restore that auto-saves the current version first.

sources.title: Filter interface design practices
sources.notes: Filter chip overflow handling: a horizontally scrollable chip row, grouping excess filters into a single expandable chip, a visible clear-all control, and stable chip order on selection.

sources.title: Accessible image crop editor controls
sources.notes: Image crop editor: ratio picker as keyboard-reachable controls, nudge controls that repeat while held, and a crop selection that keeps its place when the container resizes.

sources.title: Video player accessibility best practices
sources.notes: Audio description as a separate track narrating visual information not conveyed in dialogue, fitted into natural pauses, offered beside captions, with keyboard-operable player controls.

sources.title: Research-based web design guidelines: external links
sources.notes: External-link departure: state the destination in plain words so people know where a link leads, and warn before transfer to an outside site with an interim notice.

sources.title: Picture-in-picture interaction guidance
sources.notes: Picture-in-picture: tap reveals play, restore, and close controls; double-tap toggles window size; drag to move, stash at an edge, pinch to resize, swipe away to dismiss.

sources.title: Printable websites checklist
sources.notes: Print-friendly view: hide navigation, sticky elements, and banners in print; repeat table headers; avoid orphaned headings; print link destinations; keep charts readable in print.

sources.title: Accessibility colour tools
sources.notes: Contrast ratios for normal and large text, palette contrast checks, component contrast for borders and focus indicators, and colour-vision simulations; text must not rely on hue alone.

sources.title: Guest checkout definition and conversion
sources.notes: Guest checkout collects only what fulfilment needs; after the order completes, a single optional step can save the details already given as an account without adding friction before purchase.

sources.title: Sensitive content warnings in messages
sources.notes: Detected sensitive images and videos are blurred with a warning offering guidance, blocking, or viewing; the person can unblur and blur again, and warnings stay configurable per setting.

sources.title: Order tracking page guidance
sources.notes: Show the expected delivery date, shipping method, carrier, destination, latest update, and recent activity on one tracking view; explain delays, backorders, split shipments, and failed attempts in place, and keep a support route beside delays and order details.

sources.title: Automated-to-human support handoff
sources.notes: Hand off on an explicit request for a person, on money or liability decisions, where no confident match exists, or on repeated frustration; collect context once, never loop, and state who replies, in which channel, and roughly when.

sources.title: Promo code entry
sources.notes: Confirm an applied code at once with the discount shown beside the recalculated total; where a code fails, name the reason and offer a constructive next step, such as checking the entry or browsing other available offers.

sources.title: Subscription plan change proration
sources.notes: Upgrades usually take effect at once with a prorated charge for the remaining period; downgrades usually take effect at the next renewal, keeping the higher tier until then, so the change, its charge, and its date must be stated before confirmation.

sources.title: Time picker component guidance
sources.notes: Typed entry beside a visual picker, format conversion between 12-hour and 24-hour display, and free entry where times are not restricted to a list.

sources.title: Verification-code input guidance
sources.notes: Pasted and autofilled codes spread across entry slots, backspace stepping back without trapping focus, and a server-enforced resend wait.

sources.title: Background-task progress guidance
sources.notes: Named task states, plain detail lines stating whether the person may leave, per-context progress placement, and a task list for work longer than a minute.

sources.title: Message reactions guidance
sources.notes: Long-press reaction bar with a small fixed set plus a full picker, tap to add or remove, highlighted own reaction, and a reactors list opened from the reaction cluster.

sources.title: Pinned message guidance
sources.notes: A pinned message shown as a banner at the top of a chat, tapping the banner to reach the original message, and confirmation before replacing or unpinning a shared pin.

sources.title: Live broadcast chat overlay guidance
sources.notes: Readable chat over a moving picture: high-contrast text with a backing, a limit on message count and display time, keeping the overlay clear of captions and other controls, a quick hide action, and never showing private messages, moderator notes, or messages held for review.

sources.title: Message edit and delete guidance
sources.notes: Editing a sent message in place with an edited marker, stating a correction that changes meaning rather than silently replacing text, and deleting with a stated scope and a placeholder where a message was removed.

sources.title: Poll activity guidance
sources.notes: Single-choice and multiple-choice polls, live results display, starting and taking part in a poll, and resetting or editing a poll after creation.

sources.title: Swipe-to-reveal and swipe-to-delete guidance
sources.notes: Partial and full swipes revealing list-item actions, keeping a non-gesture alternative for every action, and undo for destructive actions.

sources.title: Countdown timer accessibility guidance
sources.notes: Static end-of-sale text preferred over a ticking clock; live countdowns announced at most once a minute; purely visual timers hidden from assistive technology with a worded end statement nearby; timers anchored to a real deadline.

sources.title: Age gate guidance
sources.notes: Neutral age gates with nothing pre-selected, date-of-birth, age-slider, or platform-account collection methods, jurisdiction-dependent requirements, and pass, challenge, or blocked outcomes with a decline route.

sources.title: Kanban board stages, columns, and work-in-progress limits
sources.notes: Stage columns and swimlanes, work-in-progress limits as a guard against overload, commitment and delivery points, and colour-independent card differentiation.

sources.title: Automated-to-human handoff escalation playbook
sources.notes: Escalation triggers for requests, repeated failure, and steps needing judgement or authority; a compact transfer package of intent, status, prior steps, and reason; keeping the conversation in the same channel.

sources.title: Discount and promo-code checkout rules
sources.notes: One-code limits with a named rejection rule, named failure reasons instead of a bare rejection, discount shown as a line item beside the recalculated total, and stacking precedence stated before payment.

sources.title: Comment mentions and notification guidance
sources.notes: Mentions address specific people in a discussion with a notification to the mentioned person, a suggestion list after the mention trigger, distinct styling for a mention, and a control to switch mention notifications off.

sources.title: Master-detail layout variations
sources.notes: Master-detail variations: split view, drill-down page, popup, and expand in place, with list and detail pairing rules.

sources.title: Chat bubble patterns including threaded replies
sources.notes: Threaded replies grouped around a parent message, with the parent kept visible and unread replies signalled.

sources.title: Gifting flow guidance
sources.notes: Gift ordering: explicit gift designation, hiding prices from the recipient, and a personalised message with the order.

sources.title: Saved address search at checkout
sources.notes: Saved addresses at checkout: showing only the default once many addresses are saved, with a change action and search to pick another, and an explicit no-address-selected state where no default exists.

sources.title: Delivery date and time slot selection at checkout
sources.notes: Delivery scheduling at checkout: choosing a date first, then an open time window, with lead time, working days, blocked dates, and slot capacity shaping what stays available.

sources.title: Delivery time slot capacity and availability rules
sources.notes: Full time windows removed from checkout choices while the date stays open where other windows hold capacity, and a full date disabled in the calendar; availability rules must match what fulfilment can actually serve.

sources.title: Product variation page experience improvements
sources.notes: Variation selection: instant and visible price updates per chosen combination, large touch-friendly option controls, and stock stated beside each option instead of an error only at add-to-cart.

sources.title: Accessible colour and size variant swatches on product pages
sources.notes: Variant swatches as a named single-choice group with real named controls, selected state exposed beyond colour alone, visible keyboard focus, and a visible border for pale swatches.

sources.title: Booking patterns that cut drop-offs and no-shows
sources.notes: Make cancelling easier than skipping a visit; a reschedule link in every reminder turns a missed visit into a released slot, the cancellation policy is stated at booking, a calendar addition is offered on confirmation, and a freed slot is offered to the next waiting person.

sources.title: Screen reader live region guidance
sources.notes: Live regions present from initial load, polite announcements by default for status changes, interrupting announcements reserved for time-critical updates, and whole versus changed-part announcement scope.

sources.title: Password reset UX: make recovery clear and safe
sources.notes: One plain request screen with a neutral response that does not reveal whether an account exists; a single-use, expiring reset link or code with a dedicated expired-link screen; stated password rules before submission, paste allowed, and a success state with a sign-in route plus a separate account notification.

sources.title: Self-serve order cancellation before fulfilment
sources.notes: A clearly labelled cancellation route for orders not yet fulfilled, a short confirmation step, and a written confirmation once the request is in; cancellations cover unfulfilled orders while returns cover fulfilled ones, so the request must reach fulfilment fast.

sources.title: In-app feedback patterns
sources.notes: Feedback elements paired with containers by research objective: rating scales, yes-or-no questions, open response fields, multiple choice, visual feedback with screenshots for layout or factual problems, and user-chosen topic tagging.

sources.title: Gift card purchase and redemption UX
sources.notes: Gift cards treated as a payment method rather than a discount voucher: partial redemptions, a balance that stays for later orders, a code that is easy to copy, and stated limits on redemption.

sources.title: Bug report form questions, template and best practices
sources.notes: Structured problem reports: title, description, steps to reproduce, severity, environment, and screenshot; few required fields in plain language, with a stated route after submission.

sources.title: Gift card purchase and redemption workflow
sources.notes: Gift cards redeemed in the cart or at checkout as a payment amount, a balance check from the account area, redemption into store credit, and the applied amount reflected in the order summary.

sources.title: Stored payment methods in checkout
sources.notes: Stored cards shown by brand and last four digits and preselected at checkout, multiple stored cards deletable during checkout, and the payment form resetting when all stored cards are removed.

sources.title: Video player accessibility guidance
sources.notes: Chapter markers on the seek bar and a chapter menu for navigation; transcript placed outside the player container so it stays available in fullscreen; state announcements only for confirmed changes such as play, pause, seek landing, captions, and volume.

sources.title: Waitlist form mechanics: capacity, priority, and promotion workflow
sources.notes: Waitlist entries move through stated states from waiting to offered, with a priority order, an offer that carries an expiry, and promotion of the next entry when an offer expires unanswered.

sources.title: Mobile app loyalty rewards design examples
sources.notes: Loyalty balance paired with the next useful reward and the gap to it; available and pending balances distinguished; earning rules, point value, exclusions, and expiry stated plainly; unavailable inventory kept out of the redeemable list; history kept consistent after returns and reversals.

sources.title: What is URL unfurling? Link previews explained
sources.notes: A pasted link expands into a preview card built from the destination title, short description, and image, with a plain-link fallback where those details are missing; a sender can switch a preview off, and only one preview is shown where several links appear.

sources.title: Home-screen widget design guidance
sources.notes: Widget sizes as separate designs: small tiers glanceable and focused, larger tiers showing more data; content kept dynamic with a stated refresh cadence; each element tapping through to the matching in-app view.

sources.title: Deep-link navigation state guidance
sources.notes: A deep link should recreate the navigation state a person would reach by tapping there normally, with a coherent back stack, matching navigation selection, and a fallback where the destination cannot be reached.

sources.title: Progressive disclosure directives
sources.notes: Progressive disclosure as a timing strategy: immediate task needs stay accessible, deeper complexity is revealed under the person's control, context is preserved across expansion and collapse, and patterns stay predictable.

sources.title: Self-service billing portal patterns
sources.notes: A billing view for an existing customer should state the current plan, next charge, and payment method first, list invoices with period, amount, status, and a document route, and state any prorated charge at the moment of a plan change rather than leaving it for the next invoice.

sources.title: Accessible password meters
sources.notes: A password strength indicator must not rely on colour alone: pair the indicator with a text label, keep contrast sufficient, and make every status change available to assistive technology.

sources.title: Reviews and ratings summary
sources.notes: A rating summary should show a decimal average with the total number of reviews, a full distribution across rating levels, and filters that let readers find relevant reviews.

sources.title: Activity feed components and grouping
sources.notes: An activity feed should group related events with a collapse rule, hold live updates behind a count rather than shifting content under the reader, show relative timestamps with the exact time available on demand, and use a connecting line only where order and elapsed time carry meaning.

sources.title: Multi-factor enrolment experience guidance
sources.notes: Enrolment should offer several methods with a chosen default, pair a QR code with a typed secret alternative and a text description, and use a suitable code-entry control with autofill support.

sources.title: Sticky headers and screen magnification
sources.notes: A pinned header should stay compact and be tested at high zoom and with keyboard navigation; where pinning is not needed, keep the header in the normal page flow.

sources.title: Form error reporting guidelines
sources.notes: Validate on leaving a field rather than while typing, re-check after an invalid mark so errors clear on correction, keep messages beside fields, and pair a focused submit-time error summary with the inline messages.

sources.title: Theme toggle placement and stored-preference behaviour
sources.notes: A quick header control should offer only the opposite of the current appearance, the three-way follow-system, light, or dark choice belongs in a dedicated settings view, nothing is stored until the person chooses, toggling back to the system-matching appearance clears the stored value, and a stored choice is never cleared on its own when the system preference later matches it.

sources.title: Restore purchase meaning and flow
sources.notes: A restore control in the paywall or settings re-applies eligible past purchases without a new charge; consumable items already spent are not restored, and a restore that finds nothing eligible should state that plainly with a sign-in or help route.

sources.title: Emoji picker component guidance
sources.notes: A symbol picker combines search, grouped categories, a recents group, a skin-tone selector, and a hover preview, with a configurable element order.

sources.title: Subscription usage view
sources.notes: A subscription usage view shows plan limits and monthly counts, resets counts at the start of each month, warns when use approaches and reaches the allotted total, and stops processing once the total is reached.

sources.title: Read progress bar implementation
sources.notes: A reading progress indicator tracks one content container, fills as that content is read, stays fixed while the page moves, and uses a labelled progress element so the value is available to assistive technology.

sources.title: Provide search
sources.notes: A friendly search capability includes autocomplete, results grouped under headings where appropriate, an easy way to find previous searches, and spell-checking with suggested corrections.

sources.title: Design Guidelines For Better Notifications UX
sources.notes: Notification guidance covers sending slowly at first, grouping updates, and letting people snooze or pause notifications for a stated period rather than clearing them unseen.

sources.title: Draft messages and draft lists
sources.notes: Drafts are saved when a person leaves unfinished work, shown as labelled previews in lists, restored into the composer on return, and cleared once sent or explicitly discarded.

sources.title: Allow reorders
sources.notes: Reorders are made from the order list or the order detail view; the control is disabled where an item is unavailable, out of stock, or disabled; items already in the cart stay when reorder items are added.

sources.title: Notification settings design
sources.notes: Group notification preferences by topic, lay categories against channels in a matrix, default to restraint for promotional updates, and treat the settings screen as part of the notification feature rather than an afterthought.

sources.title: Understand split payments
sources.notes: An order total can be broken into parts, each tied to a different payment method instance, with a single-payment setting alongside; partial payments keep the order pending until the full cost is authorised.

sources.title: Selection patterns
sources.notes: Text selection is shown by highlighting a contiguous segment; on touch surfaces handles sit at both ends, and actions appear in a menu placed beside the selection without overlapping it, with further actions behind a secondary step.

sources.title: Order returns: customer experience
sources.notes: A return request starts from the order, naming the items, quantities, reason, and preferred outcome; the request carries a stated status from issued to completed or declined, shown on the order details page.

sources.title: How to write back-in-stock alerts that create urgency without spam
sources.notes: A restock alert names the exact item and variant wanted, keeps one primary action, states honest scarcity, sends promptly while stock lasts, and offers a plain way to stop.

sources.title: Understanding restricted permissions with minimum scope alternatives
sources.notes: System pickers give a privacy-oriented path for contacts: the person chooses specific contacts or fields in a system surface instead of granting broad address-book access.

sources.title: Product tour guide: boost activation and retention
sources.notes: Product tours guide toward one activation goal in a few steps with a skip option and re-access; task lists and onboarding checklists give a visible list of setup tasks with progress, and checklists suit setup sequences spanning several separate actions.

sources.title: Seat selection map accessibility guidance
sources.notes: Keyboard-operable seating charts: every seat focusable with a row-and-number label, availability and selection stated in text or shape as well as colour, and a list alternative to the visual map.

sources.title: Selecting an option from a list pattern
sources.notes: Choosing a selection control by list length: visible checkbox or radio groups for short lists, select menus or searchable comboboxes for long lists, and a custom option revealing a text field with an add-another control for further custom values.

sources.title: Spatial home control map guidance
sources.notes: A spatial home view placing device controls where the devices sit, with zoom into rooms, switching between floors, filtering by device type, and device state shown in place such as light colour and brightness.

sources.title: Tracked changes with comments integration guidance
sources.notes: Suggestion review in shared documents: a proposing mode separate from direct editing, discussion threads linked to proposed changes, and resolving or deleting a linked thread accepting or rejecting the proposal, with accept-all and reject-all previews.

sources.title: Accessible step indicators for multi-step checkout flows
sources.notes: Step indicators in multi-step flows: the current step marked for assistive technology with a current-step token, completed steps distinguished from future steps, and the current position announced so a step list never reads as identical labels.

sources.title: Follow design pattern: examples and best practices
sources.notes: Follow as a standing subscription to a topic, theme, channel, or person: the person selects subjects to stay up to date with, and related updates appear in their update stream, distinct from saving a single item for a later return.

sources.title: Character count accessibility tests
sources.notes: Character count shown below the field with remaining count visible, announced to assistive technology on entry, and over-limit feedback stating how many characters over the limit were entered.

sources.title: Copy to clipboard pattern guidance
sources.notes: Copy actions name the payload where the context does not, a shortened display still copies the full value, failure keeps a manual copy path with the failure stated plainly, and copying is kept distinct from later setup steps such as installation or verification.

sources.title: Address forms guidance
sources.notes: Address entry asks only for needed fields in locale order with locale postal-code wording, a single name field, a second address line hidden behind a reveal control, suggestions that fill editable fields with a manual entry route, and the full address stated for checking before use.

sources.title: Live Activities accessibility guidelines
sources.notes: Live Activities follow an ongoing task from the lock screen, standby view, and compact system area: one task per activity, compact, minimal, and expanded presentations, stale updates marked, and the activity ended when the task finishes.

sources.title: Pausable downloads guidance
sources.notes: Downloads keep already-fetched progress when paused or interrupted, resume rather than restart, and only offer resumption where the resource and server support it.

sources.title: Destructive actions pattern guidance
sources.notes: Destructive actions use a confirmation step stating the object and its consequences, a cancel action as easy to reach as confirm, and an outcome statement, with undo offered where recovery is possible.

sources.title: Delivery notes validation guidance
sources.notes: Delivery notes work when they are short, specific, and compatible with the delivery method: access details, a named safe place, and instructions that conflict with the method or the item are caught before fulfilment.

sources.title: Chat app design best practices
sources.notes: Replying to a specific message keeps a response attached to its context in group and long conversations, with a preview of the original message shown above the reply.

sources.title: Switch accessibility guidance
sources.notes: Switch label describes the on state and stays fixed when the state changes; state text is separate from the label; compact switches use a tick mark in the on state so state does not depend on colour alone.

sources.title: Buy now, pay later explained
sources.notes: Splitting a total into instalments works when the schedule, each amount and date, and the total cost including any charges are shown before confirmation, and the remaining balance stays viewable after purchase.

sources.title: Subscription skip and pause policy guide
sources.notes: Skip, pause, and cancel are three different actions: a skip drops one order without charge, a pause stops orders until a stated return date, and a visible cutoff date decides which order a change applies to.

sources.title: Click and collect guide
sources.notes: Click and collect works when stock shown online matches stock on the shelf, each point states what it can supply, and the holding period is stated when the order is ready.

sources.title: Design principles for real-time captions in video calls
sources.notes: Live captions in calls work when captions stay visible and movable, speakers are labelled, uncertain wording is shown and corrected in place, and caption preferences sit beside other call settings and are remembered.

sources.title: SaaS workspace and organisation switcher UX patterns
sources.notes: Workspace switcher pattern: current-workspace legibility on every screen, wrong-workspace action harm, quiet single-workspace state, search and ordering at scale, separation from profile menu and main navigation.

sources.title: Design Accessible Charts
sources.notes: Accessible charts: never let colour be the only difference between series, label lines and bars directly, give every chart a text alternative stating the finding, provide the underlying data, and do not hide meaning in a tooltip since values only on hover are unreachable by touch and keyboard.

sources.title: Data table with expansion, column pinning, and column visibility
sources.notes: Data table with column pinning, column reorder, column visibility persisted with column order, row selection, and row expansion with a custom expansion slot and hierarchical sub-rows.

sources.title: Add-to-calendar button for event creation
sources.notes: Calendar links for several calendar services from one button, timed, all-day, recurring, and multi-date events, calendar subscription links, and localised labels.

sources.title: Room and resource booking: simple rules to stop conflicts
sources.notes: Shared room and equipment booking: one place to check availability, buffer times treated as blocked time, approval rules for high-demand resources, bundle behaviour when one item is unavailable, and instant release when a booking is cancelled.

sources.title: Multi-stop route planning with ordered waypoints
sources.notes: Route waypoint collection: address suggestions, map-tap entry with a readable address, drag and keyboard move reordering, and numbered markers that update as the stop order changes.

sources.title: Boarding pass display guidelines for wallet passes
sources.notes: Pass display guidance: button placement on confirmation surfaces, pass information modules, and image and contrast guidance for scannable passes.

sources.title: Shared cart for collaborative purchasing
sources.notes: Several people view, add, or remove items in one shared cart before purchase, shared through a cart link, with sensitive personal and payment data visible only to its owner.

sources.title: How to manage expired cards for recurring payments
sources.notes: Expired stored cards cause failed recurring charges; flag cards expiring in the next 30 to 60 days, notify in advance, stop reminders once updated, and offer a backup payment method.

sources.title: Undo send: delayed delivery with a short cancellation window
sources.notes: Sending is held for a short configurable delay; an undo control in that window returns the message to the compose view for editing, discarding, or resending, and once the window ends the message goes as addressed.

sources.title: Ticket transfer guide
sources.notes: Transfer offers with recipient acceptance, pending state with expiry, sender cancellation before acceptance, return on decline or expiry, and single-use transfer limits.

sources.title: Autocomplete UX: suggestions on focus, tap-ahead refinement, and diverse suggestions
sources.url: https://smart-interface-design-patterns.com/articles/autocomplete-ux/?text=Five Simple Steps For Better Autocomplete UX
sources.notes: Show suggestions on focus, not only after typing; tap-ahead refinement appends a suggestion to the query without running the search; show a diversity of suggestion kinds (keywords, categories, items with thumbnails) and offer filters for large suggestion sets.

sources.title: Ecommerce product configurator guide
sources.notes: Guided selling journeys narrow a large option catalogue by stated use; on every selection, constraint rules decide what stays valid, price is computed live, and a visual preview shows the build; invalid combinations must be prevented at selection, not discovered at checkout.

sources.title: Touch on desktop: larger targets, temporary control expansion, and touch routes for hover actions
sources.notes: On desktop systems where touch is a secondary input, keep layout and control sizes stable across inputs, enlarge tap targets beyond visible bounds, show a temporary enlarged control while touched and briefly after lift, reveal hover actions with a tap near the content without activating, offer essential actions in a touch-and-hold context menu, and design touch for brief intentional interactions with keyboard and pointer paths kept complete.

sources.title: Tree view accessibility: keyboard navigation and expanded state
sources.notes: A tree view takes a single tab stop with arrow-key navigation: right expands a closed branch or moves into its first child, left collapses an open branch or moves to the parent, up and down step through visible nodes, and selection uses Space or Enter; branch nodes carry an expanded state and nodes carry a selected state.

sources.title: Cancellation save flow: pause and downgrade options with transparent resume dates
sources.notes: Offer a pause for a temporary gap and a downgrade for a smaller ongoing need, with one decision per screen and the cancellation path always visible; state what access continues, when billing resumes, and the effective date for each change, label paused or downgraded accounts with plain time-based status, and send a pre-resume reminder so a resumed charge is never a surprise.

sources.title: Timeline interface design: scheduling, dense-data, and history patterns
sources.notes: A scheduling timeline lays planned work over a shared time axis with labelled scales, colour-coded status, and visible dependencies; dense timelines use zoomable scales, grouping and clustering, and filtering and search to stay readable; a history timeline keeps past, current, and planned items distinct and labels planned items as planned.

sources.title: Electronic signing: draw, place, and apply a signature
sources.notes: A signing dialog shows a document preview with a floating signature pad for drawing a signature, which can be re-drawn before applying; the signature is dragged to its position and resized, a date stamp is placed beside it, applying embeds the signature and date, and the document list shows a signed badge with the signer name and signing date recorded; a signature can also be requested from another person, who is notified and follows the same steps.

sources.title: Signing order for multiple signers and documents
sources.notes: A signing order controls the sequence in which signers take part: a signer participates only after all signers with a lower order have finished, while signers sharing an order may sign at the same time; a document order presents the lowest-order document first and moves to the next only after the previous one is signed, whereas without an enforced order a signer may browse and sign in any order.

sources.title: Presenting instalments at checkout without confusing the total
sources.notes: Keep the full order total in charge at the payment step, present one instalment option completely with number of payments, amounts, interval, interest, and missed-payment consequence in plain words, signal any approval check before the choice with its duration and the no-order outcome if not approved, offer an earlier eligibility check where available, and keep pre-checkout instalment wording tied to the actual order total and conditional.

sources.title: Synchronised audio and transcript editing for long recordings
sources.notes: Keep audio on one side and its transcript on the other, always in sync: choosing a position in the audio moves to the matching text for editing, and choosing text moves playback to the matching audio; make segment timing edits visual and immediate, and let behaviour such as confirmation prompts be adjusted to the task.

sources.title: Slider - Accessible design of user interface elements
sources.notes: Use a slider only for a value from a continuous range where an approximate value suffices; show the current value in text; operate fully by keyboard with arrow keys for one step, page keys for a larger step, and Home and End for the ends; name each thumb of a two-thumb range for the end it controls.

sources.title: Designing referral program interfaces
sources.notes: State the benefit for each side and the qualifying action before sharing; keep conditions beside the benefit; show referral progress through invited, signed up, qualified, and rewarded states without overstating completion; keep the history free of unnecessary detail about the invited person's activity.

sources.title: Payment UX standards for ecommerce checkouts
sources.notes: Keep the order summary visible at the payment step; offer at least one third-party payment option as a fallback when a card fails, chosen deliberately rather than by redirection; give field-specific error messages and a recovery path that keeps the order intact instead of forcing a restart.

sources.title: CSV import UX: field mapping, validation, and error recovery
sources.notes: Define the commit policy before the primary action; keep the mapped preview available when going back; tie each error to a specific row and field with the original value; state whether a reported row number includes the header; distinguish blocking errors from warnings.

sources.title: Saved search email alerts
sources.notes: Alerts fire when a newly added record matches a saved search, with an option to also fire when an existing record changes to match; an inactive saved search does not trigger its alerts; recipients, subscription options, and message text are set on the saved search itself.

sources.title: Pause a subscription
sources.notes: Pause at the end of the billing period or immediately; offer a set of fixed pause durations; a paused plan stays paused until resumed, and resuming early is always possible; on resume, either start a new billing period or continue the existing one; state what access continues while paused.

sources.title: Provide help for forms and non-standard controls
sources.notes: For complex forms, multi-step flows, unusual interactions, non-standard controls, and required fields that do not support automatic filling, give explanations and examples that make the expected action easy to understand; prefer standard controls, and give non-standard ones instructions or help beside them.

sources.title: Accessible form guidance
sources.notes: Do not move focus to an input automatically on load; group related inputs with a named grouping; give each input an error message that is read on focus; size fields to the expected input; avoid multi-column form layouts and submit controls placed away from the form end.

sources.title: Magic link sign-in
sources.notes: A sign-in link that completes sign-in on first fetch can be spent by an automated preview or mail scanner before the person sees it; the landing page should require an explicit confirmation, and an expired or already-used link needs its own screen with a fresh-link route rather than a generic failure.

sources.title: Document scanner guidance
sources.notes: Document scanner flow: automatic capture with document detection, accurate edge detection for crop results, automatic rotation, editing to crop, apply filters, remove shadows and stains, reorder pages, import from gallery, and a page limit; processing on-device.

sources.title: Checkout flow UX optimization
sources.notes: Keep the checkout flow linear and predictable; standardize the review step so no new fees or costs appear there; surface terms and fees early, with the total order cost visible before payment is committed.

sources.title: Navigation template for driving
sources.notes: Driving navigation template: full-screen map with an optional routing card showing the current step with direction icon, distance, and cue text, optional lane guidance and next-step preview, a travel-estimate card with arrival time, time left, and distance left, a message state for arrival or route failure, and a spinner state for calculating or rerouting.

sources.title: Mastering pre-orders in e-commerce UX
sources.notes: Preorder product pages state the release date and shipping timeline beside a distinct preorder action, keep payment terms plain — full price or deposit with the balance due on release — and manage expectations with updates when dates change.

sources.title: Tooltip best practices: remove friction, guide users
sources.notes: Tooltips only for small supplemental gaps tied to one element, not multi-step workflows; dismissible, hoverable, persistent, keyboard-focus reachable; short copy; triggered by specific observable behaviour; touch users need an explicit trigger without hover; judge a tooltip by whether users pass the friction it addresses.

sources.title: 4 In-App Announcement Patterns That Get Seen (Without Being Annoying)
sources.notes: In-app announcement surfaces matched to impact: badge with unread count for opt-in ongoing news, slim top bar with one action for broad changes, corner card for single-feature discovery without blocking, modal only for blocking or terms changes; show once, then keep the detail in the changelog feed.

sources.title: In-App Messaging Best Practices (2026)
sources.notes: Match message format to importance and urgency; never show a modal during a critical task, wait for a natural pause; segment by relevance so only affected people see an announcement; cap modal frequency to once per person per announcement, with a badge or dot for new widget content instead of repeated auto-opening.

sources.title: Splitting one order into two parcels without lying to anyone
sources.notes: Split orders as separate shipments with one order-level charge: never a single order-level progress bar, one tracking route per shipment, and the order state folded from its shipments rather than taken from the latest event.

sources.title: Mastering Price Alerts in E-commerce UX
sources.notes: Price alerts with a stated trigger and threshold, timely delivery, and easy management including pause and stop; only the first fall past the trigger is reported.

sources.title: WooCommerce Order Status Page: Stop WISMO Emails
sources.notes: Guest order lookup guarded by requiring both the order reference and the billing email, since a reference alone is guessable; rate limiting on the form and no caching of personal order results.

sources.title: Tip Screen: Best Practices and Pitfalls
sources.notes: Tip screens with preset percentages, a custom amount, and an explicit no-tip choice at equal emphasis; clear totals, no forced tip step, and prompts only where tipping is expected.

sources.title: Accessibility module feature overview
sources.notes: Chart accessibility layers: keyboard navigation of data points and controls, screen-reader exploration with a data-table view, pattern fills and distinct markers instead of colour alone, and sonification that plays a chart as sound to convey trends without visuals.

sources.title: Trial Countdown design pattern: examples and best practices
sources.notes: Trial countdown shown as a persistent fact, not pressure: days remaining visible, a reminder a few days before any charge stating the amount, and a decision page with plan choice and cancel side by side.

sources.title: Remote sign-out of devices by account
sources.notes: Reviewing signed-in devices and sessions, signing out one device or all devices remotely, and securing the account after removing an unfamiliar device.

sources.title: Incident communication stages and update cadence
sources.notes: Staged incident updates from investigating to resolved, updates on a stated cadence even with nothing new, plain-language cause and scope, and a resolution statement with what happens next.

sources.title: Item substitution preferences for unavailable items
sources.notes: Per-item substitution preferences set before picking, same-size-or-larger and same-category replacement rules, and removal where no suitable substitute exists.

sources.title: Meeting controls checklist for reliable calls
sources.notes: Five core in-call controls (microphone, camera, screen sharing, app focus, participant panel), pre-call checks per control, share-window choice before sharing, and a manual fallback path when a shortcut fails.

sources.title: Disclosure guidance for sponsored and affiliate content
sources.notes: Plain labels at the start of a recommendation, affiliate link labels placed beside the link, and a disclosure that stays with shared or quoted content.

sources.title: Product pages with in-store availability
sources.notes: In-store availability shown after a store check or location entry, with the item availability and store location shown without further interaction, and a store counting as in stock where the item can be collected today or tomorrow.

sources.title: Device pairing methods: auto-scan, code, and direct-network fallback
sources.notes: Pairing follows prepare, provide setup details, and complete the connection; methods include automatic discovery of nearby devices, code pairing, and a direct-network fallback where the device hosts its own temporary network, with a different method offered when the first method fails.

sources.title: Suggested-address modal: validation after entry, with accept or keep-original choice
sources.notes: A suggested-address prompt appears after entry, distinct from autocomplete suggestions while typing; the person chooses the suggested address or keeps the entered one, and uncertain results suit a warning while clearly invalid addresses suit a block.

sources.title: Hands-free step guidance: one step at a time with large text, timers, and a kept-awake screen
sources.notes: One step shown at a time in large text readable from a distance, with the screen kept awake, automatic and manual step movement, a progress indicator, and timers attached to steps with durations.

sources.title: Design safe and age-appropriate experiences: parental gates and permission requests
sources.notes: Parental gates block purchases and link-outs until a guardian completes an adult-level task; a child asks a guardian for permission to communicate or use a feature, the guardian approves from their own device, and access stays restricted until consent is obtained.

sources.title: How to split group expenses fairly: four methods explained
sources.notes: Split equally for shared consumption, by items where consumption differed, by agreed shares or percentages for structural differences, and by custom amounts for one-off arrangements; log each expense as it happens, select participants per expense, and settle up in the fewest transfers.

sources.title: Real-time audience polling: one-tap voting, live results, and presenter controls
sources.notes: Real-time polls with single-choice, multiple-choice, rating, and open-text questions; live results charts updating as votes arrive; anonymous or signed-in voting; timed polls with deadlines; presenter controls to start, pause, and close voting; large tap targets and screen-reader support.

sources.title: Picture proof of delivery on the tracking page
sources.notes: Picture proof of a delivery shown on the tracking page without sign-in; a photo showing the wrong location carries a report route with a case number for follow-up.

sources.title: Warranty claim statuses through the claim life cycle
sources.notes: Claim status changes with each action through the life cycle, from draft through approval in progress to approved, rejected, or cancelled, with a payment request sent once approved.

sources.title: Contextual menus: guidelines for grouping, labelling, and separating destructive actions
sources.notes: Contextual menus house secondary actions for a specific element; group related actions, label triggers in words rather than relying on a symbol alone, and separate destructive actions from the rest.

sources.title: Translation markup guidance
sources.notes: Translated text must be marked with the language it is written in and the language it came from, the original linked where available, and automatic translation stated plainly to the reader rather than presented as original wording.

sources.title: Receipt blocks: order confirmations, invoices, and itemised totals
sources.notes: A receipt must be exact and printable, surviving a long item list and a discount stack: order meta, itemised items, subtotal, discount, tax, shipping and total, with the payment method and the delivery address in their places.

sources.title: Changing the payment date for recurring subscriptions
sources.notes: Moving a recurring payment date shortens or extends the current cycle; a credit or extra charge may apply to the next payment, the change is reviewed in a summary before confirming, and some plans or states do not allow a date change.

sources.title: Message shortcuts and canned responses guidance
sources.notes: A saved reply is a short, reusable message kept under a trigger word, inserted into the compose view where it stays editable before sending, with values from the current conversation filled into its placeholders.

sources.title: Interface trend roundup for 2027
sources.notes: Produced-result states: specific progress text while a result is being produced, answer-first presentation in short chunks with more on demand, refine, undo, and retry beside the result, confirmation before consequential actions, and a manual route that does not depend on the produced result.

sources.title: Card details as a state-driven financial interface
sources.notes: A card view acts as a control surface with explicit states: active, locked, expired, pending replacement, and suspended. Security actions are confirmed against the current state rather than assumed, and a locked card keeps security actions available while payments are stopped.

sources.title: Rebooked after a cancellation: check the whole replacement journey
sources.notes: A replacement offer must be judged on the whole journey: compare arrival as well as departure, check a change of airport and its onward transport, check any new connection, keep evidence of what was offered and accepted, and treat compensation as a separate question from rebooking.

sources.title: Size charts: readable tables for each product
sources.notes: A size chart works as readable text with clear headings: state whether values describe the body or the garment, name the measurement method and units, connect the correct chart to each product family, and keep essential values as text even where an illustration is also shown.

sources.title: File and folder permissions
sources.notes: Sharing an item by named invitation with a stated role: view, comment, or edit; access inherited from a parent container; a member list showing who holds access and what each role can do; roles changeable and removable by those who manage access.

sources.title: Toggle switch accessibility guidance
sources.notes: Toggle switch for an immediate on-or-off setting: permanent visible label, caption for extra context, 3:1 contrast for the control and its focus style, minimum target size, keyboard operation with Tab and Space, accessible name matching the visible label, and disabled and loading states conveyed to assistive technology.

sources.title: Temporary location sharing with a set time and a stop control
sources.notes: Live location shared for a chosen span (fixed hours or until the end of the day) through a link; a visible status reminder while sharing runs, a stop control that ends it at once, and a plain ended statement once time runs out or sharing is stopped.

sources.title: Upsell feature entry and upgrade flow
sources.notes: A feature beyond the current tier stays visible as an entry point; selecting it opens an upgrade dialog stating the missing entitlement, and completing the upgrade returns the person to the feature without leaving the current view.

sources.title: Fintech UX design patterns: trust and dispute flows
sources.notes: Transaction detail views should use recognisable names and timestamps, and place a dispute route directly on the transaction rather than behind help content.

sources.title: Streak gamification behaviour patterns
sources.notes: Streak counters make consistency visible; a recovery route such as a freeze keeps one missed day from erasing weeks of progress, and a welcome back without guilt lowers the cost of returning.

sources.title: Contactless payments: tap, confirm, and troubleshoot
sources.notes: Check the amount before presenting a payment device, wait for the terminal response, and use the response to choose the next step, with a fallback method where the tap fails.

sources.title: Recording consent in meetings
sources.notes: Participants are asked for consent before a meeting is recorded, with accept or leave choices; a persistent indicator stays visible during capture, spoken notice reaches audio-only participants, and consent is asked again when the capture scope changes.

sources.title: Donations at checkout
sources.notes: A customer-funded contribution at checkout stays optional and is never preselected; the beneficiary and amount are stated beside the control, choices stay limited to presets plus a custom amount or a round-up, and the amount appears as a separate line item with its own receipt record.

sources.title: Cookie consent banners without dark patterns
sources.notes: Accept and decline carry equal size, weight, and steps on the first layer; a detail panel keeps the required category on and locked, keeps accept-all and decline-all reachable, and treats closing without saving as no consent for optional categories.

sources.title: Designing a profile picture that stays clear at small sizes
sources.notes: Keep the essential subject inside the circular crop with breathing room, preview the image at comment size as well as at full size, and simplify detail that turns to noise when small.

sources.title: Playback queue order, shuffle, and repeat modes
sources.notes: A playback queue keeps an ordered list with a current position; repeat modes are off, repeat-all, and repeat-one, and shuffle order is kept apart from the original order so the current position stays clear.

sources.title: After a data breach: an ordered action plan
sources.notes: A breach notice should name what was taken in specific terms and never ask for a sign-in through a link in the message; change the affected credential first, then anywhere it was reused, add a second check, and watch statements for unfamiliar activity.

sources.title: Update an order
sources.notes: What can be edited or cancelled depends on order status: a pending order can be edited or cancelled, a processing order allows only address changes, and a substantial change cancels the original order and creates a new one.

sources.title: Automation rule builder guide: triggers, conditions, and actions
sources.notes: Trigger-condition-action structure with multiple triggers, conditions, and actions; all-or-any condition logic; manual run; and last-run traces showing trigger time and per-step outcomes for diagnosis.

sources.title: File upload interface patterns that improve completion rates
sources.notes: Previewing a file before submission helps confirm the correct file was chosen; different types need different previews, with file name, size, and type shown beside the preview.

sources.title: Search history
sources.notes: Past searches listed newest first with date and time, re-run from the list, edited before re-running, and kept as a dated list of queries actually run.

sources.title: Passkey fallback and recovery
sources.notes: Fallback and recovery must be planned before launch: keep a working fallback beside passkeys, register more than one credential where possible, and treat a declined first prompt as normal with a clear retry route.

sources.title: Event invitation responses and guest counts
sources.notes: Attendance replies state who is invited, whether a guest may be brought, and a reply date; only questions that will be acted on are asked, with guest names collected where a guest is allowed.

sources.title: Download manager sequences
sources.notes: Downloads follow start, complete, pause-and-resume, interrupted, and restart sequences; an interrupted download is restarted for the remaining part only, and a failed download must not be shown as complete.

sources.title: Planning recall communication
sources.notes: Recall communication is planned early: identify how affected people will be told, use direct notice where contact details exist, state the risk plainly, and offer a remedy route with a way to contact the business.

sources.title: Merging user accounts
sources.notes: Merging accounts transfers roles, group memberships, and assigned items to the kept account, and is stated as irreversible, so what moves and what ceases to exist must be stated before confirmation.

sources.title: Points expiration warnings
sources.notes: Points expiry removes unused points after a set period; a warning period is chosen in advance, the warning is sent before expiry, and expiry dates can be shown per batch of points.

sources.title: Virtual waiting rooms for high-demand sales
sources.notes: Waiting rooms meter demand to capacity, show queue position and estimated wait, keep order first-come first-served, and can offer separate queues per event with priority lanes.

sources.title: Authenticate across form factors
sources.notes: Sign-in adapts to each device form factor; a television can present a QR code that a phone scans to complete sign-in with the device check, with a typed-code route beside it.

sources.title: Reading a price history chart
sources.notes: Price history is drawn as steps that stay flat until the next change, with one line per seller, a table view beside the chart, and headline figures counting only prices that held for a stated period.

sources.title: Buying a subscription as a gift
sources.notes: A gift purchase asks for the buyer's details for billing and the recipient's details for access, with an optional message, and the subscription is created for the recipient rather than the buyer.

sources.title: Scheduled delivery days and cut-off times
sources.notes: A delivery schedule can fix the days an order may arrive, and a cut-off time moves an order placed after the cut-off to the next valid delivery day.

sources.title: Loyalty tiers
sources.notes: Tier progress shows how much a member has earned toward the next tier and what is needed to reach it, with tier benefits listed per tier and a warning when a tier is about to expire.

sources.title: End-user capture guidance
sources.notes: Capture guidance asks for the whole document in frame, flat and in focus, without glare, shadows, or background text, with good-versus-poor examples and a quality check before submission.

sources.title: Splitting shared expenses with a link
sources.notes: Shared expenses need the participants, the amount, and who took part for each expense; shares can be equal, by item, or custom, and balances settle with the fewest payments.

sources.title: Gift receipts and fulfilment sheets
sources.notes: A gift receipt shows the items and a barcode but hides every price and total, so the recipient can exchange the gift without learning what was spent.

sources.title: Click and collect retail examples
sources.notes: Click and collect follows order, preparation, ready notice, and handoff, with stock by location, a ready notification, and a dedicated pickup area.

sources.title: Forward a message
sources.notes: Forwarding starts from the message itself, offers a recipient choice over conversations and contacts with a search route, and sends the chosen message on without retyping it.

sources.title: Return shipping workflow: labels, policies, and drop-off
sources.notes: Return labels can be sent digitally, included in the original package, or replaced by a code shown at drop-off, where the location prints the label; the return route and handover step shape how easy the return is.

sources.title: Private, group, and shared wish list privacy settings
sources.notes: A saved list can be private, open to invited members who can add and comment, or shared by link for viewing by anyone with the link; changing the privacy mode changes who can see it, and member additions and comments follow the mode in force.

sources.title: Read-along highlighting for spoken narration
sources.notes: Read-along highlighting: the highlight follows the words already being spoken, matched to visible text at whole-word granularity, with the current passage kept in view.

sources.title: Controlling slides shared by another participant
sources.notes: A presenter can give slide control to one or more participants while sharing, only while sharing is active; holders keep control for the current session even if sharing restarts, controls hide when presentation mode ends, and the presenter can revoke one holder or all holders.

sources.title: Chat experience guidance: onboarding to re-engagement
sources.notes: Returning to a conversation after time away: a condensed summary of unread messages, shown only above a threshold of unread items, with mentions and direct messages surfaced first, counts that separate important items from the total, and a jump to the last read message with context kept.

sources.title: Search suggestion guidance: suggestions that return results
sources.notes: Query suggestions shown as a person types, chosen only where they return results, and useful when a search returns nothing, so a failed search leads onward rather than to a dead end.

sources.title: Link preview guidance: show the destination before arrival
sources.notes: A preview page that shows the destination domain, a title and description, and security checks before arrival, so the recipient sees where a link leads before landing there.

sources.title: Changing two-factor authentication safely
sources.notes: Changing a second-factor method safely: sign in first, prepare recovery options, and switch without losing access, so a change made incorrectly never locks the person out.

sources.title: Muting a conversation without leaving it
sources.notes: A per-conversation mute control that silences notifications for one conversation while messages keep arriving, with a visible muted state and a one-action route back to alerts.

sources.title: Recipe serving scaling guidance
sources.notes: Serving-size controls that scale every ingredient amount at once, with the chosen serving count and scaled amounts carried into the printed recipe.

sources.title: Audiobook playback controls guidance
sources.notes: Audiobook player controls: chapter navigation from a table of contents, timeline scrubbing, playback speed, and a timer that stops playback on its own after a set duration.

sources.title: Motion and reduced-motion preferences
sources.notes: Reduced motion as a second design of the same transition rather than a removal of feedback: cut large, continuous, or self-starting movement, keep brief state feedback, and test the preference with a working toggle.

sources.title: Archiving chat conversations
sources.notes: Archiving moves a conversation out of the active list without deleting it, keeps it in a named archive folder, and restores it on demand or when a new message arrives.

sources.title: Prioritise and pin chats
sources.notes: Pinning keeps chosen chats fixed at the top of the inbox above the most-recent order, with a focus mode showing only unread and pinned chats, and unpinning by repeating the same action.

sources.title: Predictive back design
sources.notes: Back gesture preview: the destination is shown before the gesture commits, releasing before the threshold cancels with no state change, and touch targets are kept out of the system gesture areas at the screen edges.

sources.title: Contact picker
sources.notes: A system contact picker shares only the contacts a person selects and only the fields the task requested, supports single or multiple selection, and filters out contacts that lack a requested field.

sources.title: Scan and upload receipts
sources.notes: Receipt capture offers camera capture with long-receipt sections, recognised fields shown beside the image for review and correction, duplicate merging, and a reviewed mark once the details are checked.

sources.title: Search inside a Messenger conversation
sources.notes: Searching inside one conversation highlights every match, shows a match counter, and moves between matches, with a route back to the latest message.

sources.title: Pricing Plans: Updating the Payment Method on a Customer Subscription
sources.notes: Updating a payment method ahead of expiry keeps recurring subscriptions active; the update applies to the subscription it was made on, so each affected subscription needs its own update where the product keeps them separate.

sources.title: Vehicle Inspection Checklist for Rentals
sources.notes: A rental condition record is completed twice, at handover and at return, to the same standard, so a change is proven by comparing the two records; it covers exterior, glass, wheels, lights, interior, fluids, documents and accessories, with fuel and mileage recorded at both ends.

sources.title: Multi-party approval for sensitive actions
sources.notes: A second administrator must approve changes to sensitive settings; a pending approval stays active until it is approved, denied, cancelled, or expires.

sources.title: Parental controls for a mobile device
sources.notes: Daily limits, per-app limits, and downtime schedules for a supervised device: the device locks when a daily limit is reached, downtime leaves only calls and chosen apps available, and limits can differ by day.

sources.title: Credit card nicknames: naming a stored card
sources.notes: A nickname is a plain name chosen by the person for one stored card, so cards of the same type are told apart at a glance and the right card is chosen for a transaction.

sources.title: Exporting a chat: what the exported file contains
sources.notes: An export is a copy, not a move: a text file alone, or an archive with media included, naming omitted attachments in place; messages already deleted or expired are not included, and the exported file is a plain readable copy.

sources.title: Appointment reminders: timing, content, and change routes
sources.notes: A reminder carries time, place, and preparation with one primary action to reschedule or cancel; timing is typically a day before and again a few hours before, with a policy line for late changes.

sources.title: Shoppable videos: product overlays, timed highlights, and post-play lists
sources.notes: A product bar beside the player, products highlighted at the moments they appear, clickable hotspots on the video, and a product carousel after playback, with hover preview and click actions for viewing details or moving to purchase.

sources.title: Saved payment methods: removal and subscription effects
sources.notes: Saved methods can be removed and updated by the person; removing a method that funds an ongoing subscription also removes it from that subscription, so removal belongs in a settings view that shows existing subscriptions rather than in checkout alone.

sources.title: Availability poll comparison: slot polls and availability grids
sources.notes: Slot polls ask each participant to vote yes, no, or maybe on organiser-proposed times, while availability grids let each participant mark free hours on a shared grid and highlight the time with the most overlap; both replace back-and-forth messages with one shared link.

sources.title: Back to top pattern: appearance threshold, placement, and focus behaviour
sources.notes: Back-to-top control for long or infinite pages: appears only after a set scroll distance, sits at the bottom-right corner, and is omitted on short pages or where persistent navigation already serves.

sources.title: Shared plan member management: manager invites, pending invites, and removal with downgrade
sources.notes: A shared plan has one manager who invites members, tracks pending invites, and removes members; a removed member keeps their own account and content but loses the shared plan features and storage.

sources.title: Recurring series: master record, exceptions, and edit scopes
sources.notes: A recurring series is stored as one master record with changed occurrences kept as exceptions; edits and cancellations ask whether they cover this occurrence only, this and future occurrences, or all occurrences, and a this-and-future cancellation trims the series while a reschedule splits it.

sources.title: Pre-travel checklist: documents first, validity margins, and transit rules
sources.notes: Documents gate everything else on a trip: passport validity margins and blank pages, entry permissions and transit rules checked for every country on the route including transit stops, and critical documents kept reachable offline before departure.

sources.title: Cross-device handoff by scannable code: QR code, short link, and emailed link as alternatives
sources.notes: A scannable code carries a short-lived session token so a desktop task continues on a phone; the code sits beside a short typed link and an emailed link, and the originating device confirms when the second device connects.

sources.title: One itinerary, grouped by day, in local place time
sources.notes: A trip shown as one timeline grouped by day in the order it will be lived, times kept in the local time of the place, days with nothing planned stated quietly, and the overnight stay anchoring each day.

sources.title: Itemized bills: line items, totals, and dispute reduction
sources.notes: An itemized bill lists each item or service on its own line with description, quantity, unit price, and line total, with fees, taxes, and discounts as their own lines before the subtotal and total, which reduces disputes.

sources.title: Cancellation policy stated before booking, in confirmation, and in reminders
sources.notes: A cancellation policy states notice required, late-cancellation cost, no-show cost, and deposit handling in plain words, shown before booking and repeated in the confirmation and the reminder, with the same numbers in the short and full versions.

sources.title: Shared trip itinerary: live shared view, per-person access, and proposal costs
sources.notes: A shared trip shows the next item first, the rest of today, tomorrow folded, and tonight's stay; a change by one traveller is visible to all at once; view-only and editable scopes are set at invite time, and a view-only link shows dates, places, and links without confirmation numbers.

sources.title: Trigger-character suggestion menu in text editing
sources.notes: A floating suggestion menu triggered by typed characters, with filtering, keyboard navigation, listbox semantics, and Escape to close, used to insert an item at the caret while keeping focus in the text.

sources.title: Bottom sheet choice: pending selection, apply control, and consistent dismissal
sources.notes: A sheet for one short connected task keeps the background partly visible; tapping marks a choice pending until a named apply control applies it, every closing route discards a pending choice the same way, a drag handle is a cue only, and a search field inside a sheet is checked with the on-screen keyboard open.

sources.title: Designing for urgency: one dominant action, plain receipt, and staged request states
sources.notes: Emergency flows put one dominant action first, strip away distraction, share location and essential details at once, confirm receipt in plain words, and reveal secondary detail only after the request is sent.

sources.title: Medication management: plain-word instructions, error prevention, and visible adherence history
sources.notes: Medication management rests on plain-word instructions, error prevention, visible adherence history, and personalised plans and reminders that keep the person in control of what is shared.

sources.title: Auto-pay setup and lifecycle: separate recurring flow, stated decisions, and pause, change, and failure routes
sources.notes: A recurring payment setup keeps one-time and recurring flows separate, states the amount, schedule, and method before authorisation, and offers pause, change, and cancel routes with a plain notice before each charge and after a failure.

sources.title: Ride-booking app design: pickup confirmation, fare estimates, and driver tracking as a coordination screen
sources.notes: A ride request treats pickup confirmation as a separate decision with a labelled pin and a readable description, shows vehicle, arrival estimate, and fare in one card, tracks the driver as a coordination screen with named stages, and verifies identity with a handoff code before the trip starts.

sources.title: Appointment deposit policy: stated amount, what the deposit secures, and exactly when it is kept, moved, or refunded
sources.notes: A deposit works when the amount, what it secures, and the rule for on-time cancellation, late cancellation, and a no-show are stated before payment, with the deposit counted toward the price and moved to a new date where a cancellation arrives in time.

sources.title: Appointment waitlist workflow: fair ranking, stated offer windows, and a record of every offer and reply
sources.notes: A standby list fills open slots fairly by matching service, place, practitioner, and time, ranking candidates by a stated rule, and giving each person a clear window to accept with a record of every offer and reply.

sources.title: Medication reminder design: plain-word doses, flexible schedules, snooze, and taken-or-missed marks without pressure
sources.notes: A medication reminder names each dose in plain words with its amount and time, offers a flexible schedule with a snooze, lets the person mark a dose taken or missed in one action, and keeps a visible history without using guilt or pressure.

sources.title: Prescription refill requests: refillable list, multi-select, code scan, confirm step, and delivery tracking
sources.notes: A refill request lists only refillable prescriptions, lets the person choose several at once or identify one by scanning the code on its label, confirms the request in a separate step, states the request result plainly, and tracks delivery, with a history of past requests.

sources.title: Deposit refund status: requested, sent, or received, with the destination and the wait stated plainly
sources.notes: A deposit refund states its amount and where it is going, shows its status as processing, pending, failed, or refunded, states the reason and offers a retry where it fails, and disables the refund action once the refund is complete, with the record kept visible.

sources.title: Unified Checklist: Streamline Patient Pre-Visit Tasks
sources.notes: One unified pre-appointment checklist of pending items (forms, insurance details, arrival check-in) sent soon after booking; tasks not yet available shown greyed out with the date they become available; progress visible as items complete; reminders grow more frequent as the appointment nears for anything still undone; arrival prompt on the day itself.

sources.title: In-conversation message translation: per-message translate action, whole-conversation auto-translate, and original view
sources.notes: A message is translated from its own menu without leaving the conversation, with the source and target languages chosen and remembered for reuse; a whole conversation can be set to translate incoming messages automatically, with the original still reachable, and translations are processed on the device.

sources.title: Group conversation participant management: add and remove members, admin roles, and membership-change messages
sources.notes: Group administrators add and remove participants and manage admin rights from the member list; every addition, removal, or role change is announced to the group in the conversation itself, and a removed participant stops receiving new messages.

sources.title: Shared shopping list app that syncs in real time
